subject: New to SECR or OPEN CR

messages.author: 7e5b5bd5f09f2657
messages.subject: New to SECR or OPEN CR
parts:
Dear Folk, 

This might be a very minor problem for many of you. I have tried to run OPEN CR with 14 years of capture-recapture data. However, I am not able to get my trap file in the correct format. In my text file, the trap format is "Trap ID", "X", "Y" and "Usage with indicator". See the sample attached file.  Each year has a different day when traps were operated and a total number of sampling days. 

Please advise what arguments I should put while reading the read.capthist or read. Traps.
I am managing to get trap id x and Y with this but not usage. 

Chandan

Chandan
That is a valid detector file that can be read with tr <- read.traps(filename, detector = 'proximity') or whatever. I get

That implies a single session (year) in which different blocks of detectors were operated over 49 different days. If your layout varied between sessions (years) then you need to generate a separate file for each session as described in secr-datainput.pdf and secr-multisession.pdf.

Murray
P.S. You need to respect capitalization in R, so the packages are 'secr' and 'openCR'. I cannot promise to support openCR.
